## Prerequisites

Before installing, ensure you have:

- **Node.js 18+** — verify with `node --version`
- **npm 9+** — verify with `npm --version`
- A **MetaMask wallet** with Arbitrum Sepolia testnet configured
- **Testnet ETH** on Arbitrum Sepolia (for gas)
- **Testnet BLIND tokens** — request from the [Blindference Faucet](https://blindference.xyz/faucet)

## Global Install (Recommended for CLI)

Install the package globally to use the `blindference-agent` command anywhere:

```bash Terminal
npm install -g @abhieren/blindference-agent
```

Verify the installation:

```bash Terminal
blindference-agent --version
```

## Per-Project Install (Recommended for SDK)

For programmatic use in a project:

```bash Terminal
npm install @abhieren/blindference-agent
```

Import in your code:

```typescript TypeScript
import { BlindferenceAgent } from '@abhieren/blindference-agent'
```

## From Source

Clone the repository and build locally:

```bash Terminal
git clone https://github.com/AbhishekPanwarr/Blindference-Agent.git
cd Blindference-Agent
npm install
npm run build
```

Link for local development:

```bash Terminal
npm link
blindference-agent --version
```

## Upgrade

```bash Terminal
npm update -g @abhieren/blindference-agent
```
